approved_definition_context: EuclideanSpace real Fin n is real Euclidean n-space with the Euclidean norm and Borel structure. stdGaussian is the canonical centered probability law with independent variance-one orthonormal coordinates.

WithLp.ofLp exposes Euclidean coordinates. Matrix m n real is a finite real array. Matrix.vecMulVec w v has entry w_i v_j. Matrix.one is the diagonal identity and scalar multiplication acts on each entry.

The matrix norm is the Euclidean L2 operator norm, with its usual finite-dimensional topology. Integrable means a.e. strong measurability and finite norm integral. The matrix integral is the real Bochner integral, whose nonintegrable default is zero.
